text: I had my teeth scaled here. There was no queue when I arrived, so the clinic wasn’t crowded and I didn’t have to wait long. The female doctor was also very nice and friendly.

Had a dental emergency in BKK.
Filling needed to be re done and tooth chipped.
They couldn't do a same day appt since it was late in the day.
Fit me in 10 am the next day.
Front desk and dentist speaks good English, 40 min later all issues resolved for a great price.
I call that a WIN.
